reason: $59 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free, and I only get Saturdays with my kid. At that rate I'd maybe go twice a month, so a membership would cost more than it's worth.
objection: I only have weekends, so I'd use a membership about twice a month. Paying $59 for that, when storytime and the parks cost nothing, doesn't add up.
would_change_my_mind: A cheap drop-in or a small punch card I could use on Saturdays, or a free first visit through my church moms group so I can see if my kid likes it.
